Manifest.Name: 金属制瓶 / Metal Wine Bottles
Manifest.Author: 小粥
Manifest.Description: 将一块金属锭用于另一块金属锭，直接合成原版空酒瓶；只消耗两锭。真实纯度档位平均后向下取整，极低至完美默认产出1/3/5/7/9/10瓶，设置可调。 / Use one metal ingot on another to craft native empty wine bottles. Only the two ingots are consumed. Average true purity rounds down. Default yields: 1/3/5/7/9/10.
